purpose: Batch research planning based on credible repeated pier catches; not major-target certification or numerical approval. Supersedes use of the prior 24 excluded / 18 unresolved / 3 narrow split as the research queue.
admissionRule: Repeated species-specific local pier reports or multi-year port Pier/Dock catches can admit a candidate, even when targeting effort or exact side remains unresolved. Historical-only and single-event local evidence remains a lead. Boat-only, upstream-only, other-species and regional-only evidence cannot establish local pier catches.
selection: Explicit review decisions, not an automatic numerical score or minimum abundance threshold. Low-count repeated catches are permitted as cautious candidates.
